source.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_antigravity_adapter.py -k "terminal_contract or background or finish"

claims.claim: Native PRIMARY, REMEDIATION, and REPAIR instructions all include one shared deterministic headless print-mode contract that prohibits unfinished background and delegated work at the terminal boundary.

Successful native execution requires repository work and required commit completion, actual final HEAD capture, then builtin finish exactly once satisfying the supplied schema as the only successful terminal action.

REPAIR CONTINUE_IMPLEMENTATION and CODE_FIX retain mutation and commit authority while NO_CHANGE and FINALIZE_CANDIDATE remain read-only, and all REPAIR actions obey the same no-background terminal invariant.
The adapter remains single-invocation and fail-closed: no retry, fallback, or reroute is introduced, and terminal ERROR, missing, or malformed structured output is rejected.
Focused regressions cover all native operation types and reject weakened terminal contracts that omit background, synchronous, finish, commit, or final-HEAD rules.

Focused native Antigravity adapter tests pass, the full adapter test module passes, git diff --check passes, RESULT has no unresolved items, and the implementation changes only antigravity_adapter.py and its focused tests.
